2317-6763-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2317-6763-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Loot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4770-5301-5434-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2281-4247-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-4247-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-4247-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5220-6505-6900-7918.description:
Cast Spore Frog by paying its mana cost.
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2073-6797-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2348-4019-7762--85.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
2348-4019-7762--85.description:
Play any land card.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Overgrowth triggers, adding at least two additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-4019-7762--85.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

3197-3967-4120-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-3967-4120-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3995-6287-7308.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Horseshoe Crab and Mona Lisa are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3995-6287-7308.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mona Lisa.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4893-5326-7193.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Omni-Changeling and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Omni-Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Omni-Changeling to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Omni-Changeling by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4446-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4446-5670-6705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1379-1978-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1379-1978-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1376-1978-5517.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-1978-5517.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat

2173-2459-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1829-2173-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1850-2167-6701.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2167-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-5487-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Molten Duplication
2743-5487-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Molten Duplication twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Molten Duplications, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

539-1902-4657.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
539-1902-4657.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

1548-4636-5870-6320.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}
1548-4636-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Port Razer that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Port Razer token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Port Razer token. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

586-1270-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding nine {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2060-2577-3602.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2034-2060-2577-3602.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

509-2092-2585.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
509-2092-2585.description:
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

58-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Taskmaster, adding {R}.
When Goblin Taskmaster dies, Yedora triggers, returning Goblin Taskmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Goblin Taskmaster by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Goblin Taskmaster's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

575-1138-3510.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-1138-3510.description:
Activate Thallid Devourer's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Resolve the Thallid Devourer ability, giving it +1/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1329-1976-3338-4970.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1976-3338-4970.description:
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

549-1651-5251.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token that is also an artifact due to Biotransference.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

1242-2744-2760.notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1242-2744-2760.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it, causing target player to discard a card.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

132-2645-4131.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

3055-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

654-880-3703.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
